verdict.rationale: Wrike's pricing page lists a 'comment summary' AI feature and 'mobile inbox prioritization', which implies built-in comment threads and an inbox for team communication inside the planning tool. However, no evidence documents a dedicated team chat or real-time messaging capability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-app team chat or real-time messaging, details of comment threads and @mentions on tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can chat with my team directly inside the same tool I plan work in

citations.quote: AI Essentials include AI content and editing, comment summary, board AI, mobile inbox prioritization, and NL automation rule generation.
Help your team collaborate no matter where they are with Wrike's apps for Windows, Mac, iPhone, and Android.
